name: APM Monaco
verdict: Jewellery house founded by the Prette family in 1982; a TPG-led consortium bought 30% of it in 2019. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the founding family's remaining stake isn't stated in the sources. The 2019 buyers of 30% were TPG, China Synergy (set up by TPG and CICC Capital) and Trail; their split isn't disclosed, so CICC's indirect share can't be computed. Nothing sourced passes the test.
